bio: This lively steakhouse not far from the Isartor is fronted by a classic bar of impressive dimensions – there are over 320 types of gin to choose from here! The attractive interior design successfully brings together a certain rusticity and a touch of English elegance. Meat eaters can look forward to high-quality cuts cooked on the Montague grill – tantalising examples include US Black Angus Prime Beef and Wagyu Kagoshima A5. There are over 250 wines on the wine list. Tip: Why not sign up for one of their beef-tasting sessions? With its various lounges, the restaurant also caters to private parties....
